title: Rick Explains Neural Networks Like a Boss!
caption: Ever wondered how neural networks learn? Rick and Morty break it down! #AIExplained

scenes.script: Alright, listen up, Morty. You ever wonder how a neural network learns from data?
Uh, isn't it just some magic, Rick? Like, you wave a wand and suddenly it knows things?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: No, Morty! It's not magic. It's weights and biases, baby! The network starts as an empty canvas.

scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Weights control how much the input features matter. Biases shift decision thresholds. Think of it like adjusting knobs on your TV, Morty.
Oh! Like when I try to get the picture right, but it's all blurry?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Exactly! Now, the network makes guesses. If it's wrong, we use backpropagation to adjust those knobs.
Backwhat now? Sounds like some kind of alien disease!
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: It's not a disease, Morty! It's how the network learns. We calculate an error and adjust weights to minimize it.
So, like when I practice my math homework over and over until I get it right?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Precisely, Morty! And we do this for multiple epochs—rounds of training—until the network generalizes well.
And that's how neural networks learn, Morty. Now go impress your teacher!
